title: Committed .uproject enables UE_MCP_Bridge: unauthenticated loopback WebSocket (execute_python) auto-starts on every editor boot
evidence:
PacketPlumberUE.uproject diff hunk:
		{
			"Name": "UE_MCP_Bridge",
			"Enabled": true
		},

Verified plugin source (committed in this same PR):
UE_MCP_Bridge.cpp:18  void FUE_MCP_BridgeModule::StartupModule()
UE_MCP_Bridge.cpp:21    G_BridgeServer = MakeShared<FMCPBridgeServer>(PortChoice.Port, PortChoice.Source, PortChoice.bPinned);
UE_MCP_Bridge.cpp:53  if (G_BridgeServer->Start())   // unconditional — no opt-in flag

BridgeServer.cpp:326  // Bind socket to loopback only. The bridge has no authentication on the
BridgeServer.cpp:327  // WebSocket upgrade, so binding to 0.0.0.0 (INADDR_ANY) would expose every
BridgeServer.cpp:1722 // The bridge exposes execute_python and every editor mutation, and it
BridgeServer.cpp:1723 // authenticates nothing about the caller.
detail: Every editor session of this project silently starts an unauthenticated WS server exposing execute_python to any local process. Mitigated: loopback-only bind, browser-Origin upgrades refused, editor-only modules. Residual local-process risk remains.
recommended_fix: Gate bridge startup behind an explicit opt-in (e.g. -MCPPort-style flag or per-developer config defaulting off), or add a handshake token minted at startup; document the accepted residual risk in agent-playbook.md.
